strata_definitions.different_named: Both backends assign named categories, with different stable IDs.
strata_definitions.sol_named_native_other: Sol assigns a named category; native Decisions assigns Other, including accepted refusal.
strata_definitions.sol_other_native_named: Sol assigns Other, including accepted refusal; native Decisions assigns a named category.
strata_definitions.equal_named: Both assign the same named stable ID.
strata_definitions.both_other: Both assign Other, including accepted refusal.

confirmation.basis: Frozen challenger condition confirmation assignments only; also display corresponding Original assignments with their own catalogs, all anonymized.

selection.rule: Within each stratum choose the first min(quota,available) IDs in ascending (rank_hex,item_id) order. Never reallocate a short stratum quota.
selection.rank_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of auto-research-review-v1\0 + decimal seed + \0 + phase + \0 + modality + \0 + stratum + \0 + item_id; \0 denotes one NUL byte, not two literal characters.
selection.presentation_order: Rank selected IDs with the same framing, stratum replaced by presentation; ties use item_id.
selection.blinding: For each paired comparison use the same rank framing with stratum=blind:<comparison-role>; swap A/B when the first digest byte is at least128. Use distinct roles compact-pair, challenger-pair, original-pair. Preserve separate secret key and seal judgments before unblinding.
selection.case_id: First24 hex characters of the same rank framing with stratum=case; this is an opaque display ID.

packet_contents: Input text or exact supplied photograph bytes with neutral text
Full own catalog definitions for every presented assignment
Anonymized choices A/B and separate anonymized Original choices at confirmation

judgments.public_explanation_limit: At most two short public sentences per assignment; no chain of thought.
judgments.failure_accounting: Exactly one registered coding-harness pass per selected packet. Keep accepted, failed and not-attempted counts and all raw public judgments. No cleansing rerun or replacement case.

compute_scope: Coding-harness review is outside the experiment API call/token-dollar ledger. Record harness/model identity when known and disclose unmetered/unknown compute. It is same-family, fallible qualitative evidence, not independent human truth or population accuracy.
development_handoff: Seal selected packet, separate key, all review outcomes and actual instructions before unblinding and the single boundary-generation invocation. Include all accepted notes and failure/missing markers, not a favorable subset.
confirmation_handoff: Selection and challenger catalog are frozen before confirmation outcomes. Final qualitative review cannot alter candidate, adoption label or classifications.
